$comment: THE LEDGER LIVES ON ITS OWN BRANCH (NEW-1, owner decision 2026-11-05).
The BACKLOG / VERIFICATION records are NOT in this tree. They are one file per entry under ledger/<kind>/<state>/<ID>.md on the
`ledger` branch, which has no required checks and no pull requests — a session commits a record straight to it.
This file is the MARKER: tools that used to gate ledger edits inside a PR (scripts/check-mint.mjs, the touch guard, the git hooks)
read it via isBranchMode() in scripts/lib/ledger.mjs and stand down; ledgerRoot() then finds the shallow checkout in .ledger/.
Do not delete it without moving the ledger back. Rules: the LEDGER section of CLAUDE.md. Tool: `npm run ledger -- --help`.
